visibleSeatSupport.basis: Root actual source-visible skirt/seat support reference, not old empty-chair center or a hidden hip pivot.

visibleForearmDeskSupport.basis: Root actual visible forearm/desk support reference.

visibleHeelGroundReference.basis: Producer approximate visible heel/floor fragment only; no full two-foot contour or invisible sole proof.

jointCoverageBounds.basis: Read-only luminance>32 diagnostic envelope of actual unmodified F and S, right/bottom exclusive. Includes admitted adjacent receiver/furniture fragments; not pure anatomy or a rendered threshold.

workingPaper.basis: Visible source actor occupies left desk; paper/layout must yield to actual left coverage. Runtime layout unverified.
